title: Auxiliary Power Unit Air Intake Flap Actuator — Removal

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Removal of the intake flap actuator from the auxiliary power unit compartment, including the safety conditions that must be established before any person enters the compartment.

sections.purpose: This task removes the air intake flap actuator so that it can be replaced, or so that the flap mechanism behind it can be examined.
sections.job_setup_note: The compartment is a confined space with a fire extinguishing bottle in it. Establish the safety conditions before anyone puts a hand inside. The tail cone access stand must be rated for the working height and must be secured against the aircraft moving on its oleos as fuel is used or added.
sections.procedure: 1. Make sure that the auxiliary power unit has been shut down for at least one hour. 2. Isolate the auxiliary power unit and put the warning notice in the flight compartment. 3. Safety the fire extinguishing bottle and record the safety pin number. WARNING: DO NOT ENTER THE COMPARTMENT UNTIL THE FIRE BOTTLE IS SAFETIED. AN INADVERTENT DISCHARGE IN A CONFINED SPACE WILL DISPLACE THE AIR. 4. Put the tail cone access stand in position and secure it. 5. Open the access panels in zone 393 and the upper panel in zone 394. 6. Move the intake flap by hand to the mid position and support it. CAUTION: DO NOT LET THE FLAP FALL. IT WILL DAMAGE THE SEAL LAND. 7. Disconnect the actuator electrical connector and cap it. 8. Release the anti-rotation slot pin at the output shaft. 9. Release the four mounting fasteners at the shroud D4910119498267 and keep them together with their washers. 10. Withdraw the actuator clear of the flap arm and lower it out of the compartment on a lanyard. 11. Examine the output bearing bore and the anti-rotation slot for dust packing and record what you find. 12. Cover the mounting aperture to keep debris out of the duct in zone 396.
sections.close_out: Cap the connector and the mounting aperture. Record the as-found condition of the bearing bore, the slot and the flap seal. Where the actuator is being returned under a service bulletin, tag it with the aircraft registration and the running hours.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft; the mounting pattern of step 9 differs between the delivered and the shrouded bearing standard

safety_precautions: Safety the auxiliary power unit fire extinguishing bottle.
Secure the access stand against aircraft movement.
